top_categories.workout_context: 76 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
139ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Bento Gonçalves' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
At GFNY Bento Gonçalves, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
GFNY Bento Gonçalves' mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 76 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Bento Gonçalves. Train it until it feels boring.
10,558ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
10,558ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Base fitness for GFNY Bento Gonçalves. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At GFNY Bento Gonçalves, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
The aerobic base that lets you ride mixed terrain at tempo for 76 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Low-cadence force work for 10,558ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.

race_overlay.heat: May in Bento Gonçalves, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before GFNY Bento Gonçalves. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for GFNY Bento Gonçalves’s 76 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at GFNY Bento Gonçalves. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at GFNY Bento Gonçalves requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 76 miles of mixed terrain in Bento Gonçalves, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.
